notes: Fixed: Startup audit closed with an error when you pressed Enter, Space or T on a system-wide app. It now opens Task Manager's Startup tab like it should
Session recorder: a session cut off by a PC crash or power loss now opens, with everything it recorded up to that moment
Buttons that open a Windows page or a link (Windows Security, Windows Update, Discord, the store and more) show a message instead of an error screen on PCs where Windows can't open them
OLED guard: keeps protecting through screen changes, still finds your screen if you move it to another port, and no longer goes black during fullscreen video in Store apps like Netflix
Game profiles: Valorant's stretched res now says what it does. It gives a bigger HUD at a lower resolution; true stretch was patched by Riot, so players stay normal width
